stories.description: Peer-reviewed study demonstrates potent, multi-month extrahepatic delivery via both systemic administration-targeting skeletal muscle, heart, and adipose tissue-and localized routes across ocular, joint, and bladder compartmentsUnlocks high-value therapeutic tissues for neuromuscular, cardiovascular, and cardiometabolic diseases through CD36-mediated uptake, achieving ~90% target knockdown and functional muscle hypertrophy in non-human primates with only transient liver activityClinically validated across both systemic and local routes of administration through ongoing clinical programs RAG-18 (systemic saRNA for Duchenne muscular dystrophy) and RAG-01 (intravesical saRNA for non-muscle invasive bladder cancer)NANTONG, China, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ractigen Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering small activating RNA (saRNA) and targeted oligonucleotide therapeutics, today announced the publication of a foundational peer-reviewed study in Molecular Therapy - Nucleic Acids detailing the design, mechanism, and preclinical translation of its proprietary LiCO™ (Lipid-Conjugated Oligonucleotide) platform.

stories.title: Tackling diabetes with an electronic implant: How a tiny catalyst lowers blood sugar

Although insulin injections can bring blood sugar levels down, they do not address the body's chronic energy surplus. Insulin merely helps muscle cells take up glucose from the bloodstream, but if the body does not use that energy, the excess is converted into fat. This helps explain why many patients continue to gain weight despite treatment.
